name: Speaker shrinks into a tilted card
description: The speaker starts full-frame, then shrinks into a slightly tilted photo card with a white border and a soft shadow, centred on the clean background; the card can turn black-and-white, and an optional orange rubber-stamp word (like 'MID' or 'NOPE') slams onto it.
use_when: A verdict or judgement on what was just said: 'it's mid', 'nobody cares', 'that's the old way', 'rejected'; also a beat that steps back from the speaker to comment on him.

stamp.help: one short word stamped on the card, e.g. 'MID', 'NOPE', 'BORING'; empty = no stamp

grayscale.help: turn the card black-and-white after it lands (reads as 'the dull version')

tilt.help: card rotation in degrees, -12 to 12; negative leans left
